glyph_profile_gallery.name: Borrowed Outlines — Glyph Profile Gallery
glyph_profile_gallery.description: Six existing font-profile sculptures and their source sections: O passage, O vessel, B wells, C channel, closed I sweep and two colon bodies. Built for the existing Endless Museum host, with static collision and a clear central aisle. The O retains its sill; it is not a level doorway.
glyph_profile_gallery.qfep_connection: A type designer supplies the inherited boundary and Godot supplies its sampled triangulation. The six routes change how that boundary is used while keeping visible which holes, separations and constraints were inherited and which arise from the sweep.
interactions: Walk around each sculpture using the museum's player
Compare its flat source profile with its depth, turn, flare or closed path
Inspect the O's sill without treating it as an accessible level doorway

spatial_needs.orientation: central aisle runs along local Z
spatial_needs.footprint_source: authored; see native verification in the paired review folder
spatial_needs.entrance_exit: Centre entry and exit on local x=0 at opposite Z ends; keep the 5.2 m central aisle free.
